rows.english: Supplements fill the gaps but food fills them first. When Living Protocol identifies something your body needs, it doesn't just recommend a capsule. It tells you which everyday foods naturally contain it, so you can choose: add it at dinner, or take it from a bottle. Either way, you're knowing, not guessing.

rows.label: Section label
rows.zhCN: 为何不同

rows.label: H2
rows.english: Not just an answer. A plan that actually knows you.
rows.zhCN: 不只是一个答案，而是一套真正了解你的方案。

catalogChecks.zhCN: 而是一套真正了解你的方案。

rows.label: Paragraph 1
rows.english: Anyone can look up whether travel affects magnesium. The hard part is knowing how it affects your plan your stack, your medications, what your past few weeks looked like and what you should actually do about it. That's what Living Protocol handles.
rows.zhCN: 旅行会影响镁的吸收 — 这个答案网上随手可查。真正的难点在于：了解这件事具体如何影响你的方案 — 你的营养组合、用药情况、过去几周的状态 — 以及你实际应该怎么做。这正是动态健康方案为你处理的。

rows.label: Paragraph 2
rows.english: It already knows your full stack, so you never have to re-explain when something changes. Every adjustment recommendation is safety-checked against your medication list and lab flags a safeguard that only works when the guidance is built entirely around you. Over 90 days, it starts to recognise your patterns, and suggestions reflect what's been happening over weeks, not just today. You also don't need to know the right questions to ask you just tell it what happened, and Living Protocol does the thinking.

rows.label: H2

rows.label: Paragraph 1
rows.english: MattaNutra was born in northern Thailand. For centuries, this part of the world has quietly practised a philosophy of the right amount eating just enough, resting at the right moment, moving with the body's natural rhythms. A wisdom refined over generations.
rows.zhCN: MattaNutra 发源于泰国北部清迈。几个世纪以来，这片土地上静静流传着一种适度的生活哲学 — 吃得恰到好处、在正确的时刻休息、顺应身体的自然节律。这份智慧，在岁月中被一点一点地打磨与传承。

rows.label: Paragraph 2
rows.english: We built MattaNutra to turn that quiet wisdom into something modern, measurable and genuinely personal a plan that knows your body, adjusts as your life does, and never asks you to become someone else.
rows.zhCN: 我们创建 MattaNutra，正是为了将这份宁静的智慧，转化为现代、可量化且真正个性化的健康方案：一个真正了解你的身体、随生活变化持续调整、从不要求你做一个 " 别人 " 的方案。

rows.label: Founders H3
rows.english: Founded by physicians, scientists, and AI innovators.
rows.zhCN: 由医师、科学家与 AI 创新者共同创立。

rows.label: Founders intro
rows.english: What goes into your body should be designed by people who truly understand what happens inside it.
rows.zhCN: 为你身体摄入的每一份营养，都源于真正洞悉其内在机理的专业团队。

rows.label: Founders body
rows.english: MattaNutra was founded by an international, multidisciplinary team with an unusually broad depth of background: two physician-scientists with MD–PhD qualifications from Mahidol, Princeton, Stanford and Harvard; a software engineer whose career began at CERN and now focuses on AI and decentralised systems, with experience at Goldman Sachs and UBS; a PhD economist with a global corporate background spanning public markets and early-stage ventures; and a younger founder who keeps us closely connected to the generation we serve.
rows.zhCN: MattaNutra 由一支国际跨学科团队创立，团队拥有罕见的深度与广度：两位拥有 MD–PhD 双料学位的医师，毕业于 Mahidol、 Princeton、 Stanford 和 Harvard 等顶尖研究机构；一位软件工程师，职业起点是欧洲核子研究组织（CERN），现专注于 AI 与去中心化系统，曾服务于高盛、瑞银等顶级金融机构；一位经济学博士，深耕公开市场与前沿创业；以及一位年轻创始人，让我们始终与自己所服务的那一代人保持紧密连接。

rows.label: Founders closing
rows.english: Between us, we've accumulated more than a hundred years of professional practice in medicine, science, technology, and building products that stand up over time.
rows.zhCN: 我们之间，积累了超过百年的专业实践 — 在医学、科学、技术领域，以及打造经得起时间考验的产品这件事上。

rows.label: Q1
rows.zhCN: 我的数据隐私安全吗？

rows.label: A1
rows.english: Yes. Your assessment is yours. We don't sell it, share it with advertisers, and you can request deletion any time. Living Protocol conversations are stored only to maintain continuity of your plan.
rows.zhCN: 是的。你的评估数据只属于你。我们不出售答案，不与广告商共享，你可以随时要求删除数据。动态健康方案中的对话记录，仅用于维持你方案的连续性和一致性。

rows.label: Q2
rows.english: I'm on medication is this safe for me?
rows.zhCN: 我正在服药，使用这个安全吗？

rows.label: A2
rows.english: MattaNutra automatically screens for the most common medication-supplement interactions and flags them in your plan. This is wellness guidance, not medical advice. If you're on prescription medication, pregnant, breastfeeding, or managing a health condition, please consult a qualified healthcare professional before starting any supplement plan.
rows.zhCN: MattaNutra 会自动筛查最常见的药物与保健品之间的相互作用，并在你的方案中做出标记。这属于健康指导，而非医疗建议。如果你正在服用处方药、怀孕、哺乳，或正在管理某种健康状况，请在开始任何保健品计划前，咨询具备资质的医疗专业人士。

rows.label: Q3
rows.english: Where do the recommended products come from?
rows.zhCN: 推荐的产品从哪里来？

rows.label: A3
rows.english: Your formula is dispensed through a network of partner pharmacies with registered pharmacists so you get exactly what your plan calls for, without guessing in the aisle. We don't manufacture supplements. We match you to products worth trusting and pharmacists worth asking.
rows.zhCN: 你的知量方案由合作药房网络中的持证药师进行调配 — 你拿到的正是你方案所需的产品，无需在货架前盲目猜测。我们不自行生产保健品；我们为你匹配可信赖的产品和可以为你答疑的药剂师。

rows.label: Q4
rows.english: Is the free assessment actually free?
rows.zhCN: 免费评估真的免费吗？

rows.label: A4
rows.english: Yes. The questionnaire and Health Score are completely free with no credit card required. You'll see where you stand and an initial sense of direction. If you choose to go further, your full personalised Right Amount Formula and optional Living Protocol support is there when you're ready.
rows.zhCN: 是的。问卷和健康评分完全免费，无需绑定信用卡。完成评估后，你会看到自己的健康状况概览和初步方向。完整的个性化知量方案 — 以及可选的动态健康方案支持 — 随时可以开启。

rows.label: Q5
rows.zhCN: 为什么用巴利语命名？

rows.label: A5
rows.english: Mattaññutā means the wisdom of knowing the right amount. It comes from a 2,500-year-old tradition of practical wisdom about moderation and balance that real flourishing comes not from more, but from exactly enough. The name is our promise: we help you find your right amount, not sell you more than you need.
rows.zhCN: Mattaññutā，意为「知量之慧」 — 知晓适量的智慧。它源自两千五百年来关于适度与平衡的生活哲思：真正的活力，从不在于「更多」，而在于「恰好」。这个名字是我们的承诺：帮助你找到属于自己的知量，而不是卖给你不需要的。
